newsitem.title: UK: Powell Duffryn to incur 14.3 mln stg charge.
newsitem.headline: Powell Duffryn to incur 14.3 mln stg charge.

text.p: Britain's Powell Duffryn said on Monday it expected to incur an exceptional charge of 14.3 million stg for the year to March 1997 on select disposals it was making to focus on its core ports and engineering businesses.

The group has entered into an agreement to sell its Lemont, Chicago terminal to IMTT, a joint venture of Koninklijke Van Ommeren NV and International Tank Terminals of New Orleans for five million stg in cash.

The Lemont facility was last of the group's eight terminals to be sold. It had a book value of 8.8 million stg at March 31, 1997 and it generated an operating profit of 0.8 million stg during the year.

Powell Duffryn also sold its 50 percent shareholding in Corall-Montenay Ltd, a provider of energy management services for commercial and industrial buildings to its joint venture partner for 9.6 million stg in cash.
"The sale proceeds of these transactions will be used initially to reduce borrowings," the company said.
Powell Duffryn is expected to announce its annual results on June 5, 1997.
The company's share price closed 448 1/2 pence on Friday.
